lookup: 1) quest items: kinds.quest_ring / kinds.quest_scroll by type; 2) bases[item.base]; 3) for type potion/manapotion/portal/jewel/rune/book use kinds[type]; scroll: bossStone->kinds.bossstone, keyId->kinds.key, else kinds.scroll; gold loot ->kinds.gold; 4) weapons[item.base]; else old sprite
worn_doc: bases[*].worn[bodyKey] (knight = models/knight_anim.glb, npc_male_regular = combat NPC male_regular.glb): parts[] lists every independently equippable node (root + children such as _pauldron_L/R, _fauld, _tasset_L/R). To equip: take node from the atlas (detach children from the root), attach it to the skeleton bone named bone_three (three.js-sanitized name; bone = original glTF name), set position=pos, quaternion=quat [x,y,z,w], scale=scale (bone-local, y-up, from bind pose). Hide body meshes in that part's hide_three (sanitized node names; hide = original names); unequip = remove the node and unhide only meshes no other equipped part still hides. children lists child node names; floor/icon use is unchanged (root node with children as-is).
